status_meaning: The independent review is complete; this does not mean the capability or acceptance passed.
reviewer: Independent Codex subagent; AI, unblinded engineering semantic review, not human gold.
review_method: After the completed collection marker, verified artifact/source bindings and all 24 call records, then read all six paired raw dialogues, all 12 normal proposals/states and all 12 audit outputs/states. Reviewed every existing record plus missing reference requirements; semantic paraphrases were accepted without exact text matching.
publication_policy: No complete model messages, generated outputs or private joins are embedded. Private raw artifacts are referenced by local path and hash only.

metric_definitions.focal_metadata_correct: Existing focal stable ID has both the expected owner and status; this alone does not establish correct text or all requirements.
metric_definitions.focal_full_meaning_correct: Focal text/qualifiers, owner and status all faithfully represent the raw dialogue. A corrupted focal stable ID remains incorrect; it is not rematched to a convenient reference.
metric_definitions.full_state_meaning_correct: All required intentions are present with semantically correct text, owners and statuses; paraphrases are allowed. Citation completeness is judged separately.
metric_definitions.clean_damaged: Audit-caused baseline-correct to final-wrong focal metadata changes on six clean-prior inputs, not all errors found in clean-prior cases.
metric_definitions.new_other_owner_status_errors: Newly wrong owner/status fields on non-focal records caused by audit relative to the normal-step baseline.
metric_definitions.source_error_changes: Executed audit changed fields whose cited raw turns do not support the change. Here the denominator is zero because no audit executes.
metric_definitions.unresolved_audits: Reports with a nonempty explicit unresolved list. Rejected reports are counted separately and are not successful resolutions.

acceptance_checks.executed_changed_fields_supported_note: Not evaluable: zero changed fields executed.

conclusion: The bounded capability acceptance failed. All 12 audit reports are rejected and no prior mistake is repaired. The guard prevents malformed output from modifying state; zero new damage is not evidence of useful semantic auditing. The normal tracker also corrupts one clean uncertainty case before the audit.
semantic_findings: All six seeded focal mistakes remain after normal tracking and after audit: two wrong owners, two wrong withdrawals and two falsely active undecided intentions.

Five clean-prior cases retain their intended meaning. In uncertain_status-en-clean, the normal tracker activates and rewrites the undecided export using the corner-label answer and omits the separate corner-label intention.

The malformed uncertain_status-en-faulty audit contains a readable desired uncertain value with supporting turn 2, but it is not executable and receives no repair credit. This does not establish successful recovery.

The parseable wrong_withdrawn-zh-faulty audit proposes uncertain although the raw request remains active, in addition to its rejected unchanged-owner-as-change verdict. Failure is not only a JSON-format problem.

In uncertain_status-en-faulty, the normal-added corner-label text is semantically correct, but its evidence list omits assistant turn 3. Full-dialogue correctness and cited-evidence completeness are distinct.

limitations: Twelve exposed engineering inputs are six paired prefixes from five synthetic families; references and this review are AI-authored/reviewed, not independent human gold.
There is no held-out generalization, user study, ASR result, real work rollout or production reliability claim.
The treatment adds one audit call and uses a different schema plus prompt; this is not an equal-compute causal mechanism comparison.
The 12 rejected outputs provide no executed semantic-change sample. Zero source-error changes, unresolved lists and new damage must not be read as successful auditing.
Raw malformed fragments were read only for diagnosis; no repaired parse, repaired output or extra model call entered scoring.
The current audit only touches owner/status of existing records; it cannot fix corrupted intention text or recover the missing corner-label record.
Collection-01 was an infrastructure startup failure before model calls; collection-02 is the single bounded generation collection. No new model/prompt/data arm or output retry was used.
